name: ScrollArea
summary: A scroll container with thin styled scrollbars over native scrolling, and edge fades on the side that still has content.
useWhen: A panel, a sidebar or a list that scrolls inside a fixed height while the page stays put
A row of chips or tags that scrolls sideways inside its line
A wide table that scrolls on both axes inside a card
avoidWhen: The whole page scrolls: the browser scrollbar is the right one
A short list that fits: let it grow instead
Content that must all be seen at once, such as a form someone fills in

insteadUse.The page itself scrolls: the native page scroll, no component

orientation.description: Which axes scroll. Sets data-orientation. both adds the corner part.

size.description: The scrollbar thickness: md is scrollbar.size (6px), sm two thirds of it. The track adds space.4xs on each side.

scrollbars.description: When the scrollbars show (the Radix type). auto: while content overflows. always: always. scroll: while scrolling. hover: while the pointer is over the area.

fades.description: Edge fades on the side that still has content.

label.description: The name of the viewport when it takes focus. Under lang="ar" the default is محتوى قابل للتمرير. Name what scrolls.

focusable.description: auto: the viewport joins the tab order (tabindex 0, role region, named) only when its content overflows and it holds no focusable child.

viewportRef.description: A ref to the viewport, the element that scrolls, for scrollTo and scroll restore.

onScroll.description: Called on every scroll of the viewport.

a11y.role: none on the root. The viewport is a region named by label while it takes focus.
a11y.focus: The viewport takes focus (tabindex 0) only when its content overflows and it has no focusable child, so a keyboard user can reach it and scroll. With focusable children, Tab moves through them and the browser scrolls each into view.

keys.Tab: Moves to the viewport when it takes focus, else to the first focusable child
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: Native scrolling of the focused viewport by a line
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowRight: Native scrolling along the inline axis when it scrolls
keys.Home, End: Native scrolling to the start and the end

a11y.announce: Nothing. The scrollbars and the fades are hidden from assistive technology, which reads the content in order.
notes: Scrolling stays native: wheel, touch, keys, find in page and scroll into view all work. No custom wheel handling.
The vertical scrollbar sits on the inline end, so on the left in right to left layouts. Horizontal fades mirror too.
The keys are the browser's own scrolling of a focused scroll container, so the contract suite notes them; ScrollArea.test.tsx covers the focus rule and the overflow states.
visible and hidden are the data-state of the Radix scrollbar and thumb parts under scrollbars scroll or hover.
With orientation both, the fades and the overflow states follow the block axis only.
The thumb tokens (scrollbar.thumb) measure under 3:1 on some surfaces; the thumb is a pointer aid, the keyboard and the native scroll carry the function. Raised with the lead as a token question.
Edge fades fade into --_scroll-area-fade-color, the body color by default. A parent on another surface sets that private property to its own fill from its own CSS.

en.label: Name what scrolls, in sentence case: Release notes, Activity, Board tags.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: الملاحظات، النشاط، الوسوم.

angular.behavior: own: native overflow with the same parts drawn over it, cdk:bidi for the side

native.note: The platform draws its own scroll indicators; fades use a gradient overlay.

styles.studio: A 6px thumb on a clear track, from the scrollbar tokens. Fades into the body color.
styles.desk: The same thumb, a little lighter on the dark desk, from the Desk scrollbar tokens.
styles.neutral: The same parts on the Neutral scrollbar tokens once 1.10 lands.
styles.liquid: Planned: content scrolls under glass bars, with the scroll edge fade.

mistakes.wrong: A scroll box with no way in for the keyboard
mistakes.right: ScrollArea gives the viewport tabindex 0 and a name when nothing inside can take focus

mistakes.wrong: Replacing wheel scrolling with a script for smooth scroll
mistakes.right: ScrollArea keeps native scrolling; only the bars are drawn

mistakes.wrong: A ScrollArea with no size from its parent, so it grows and never scrolls
mistakes.right: Give the root a block size, a max block size or a flex or grid cell

mistakes.wrong: Wrapping the whole page in a ScrollArea
mistakes.right: Let the page scroll natively; use ScrollArea for panels inside it
